encode_text_with_hf_byte_bpe: encode a string into BPE token IDs using the HuggingFaceByteLevelBPE encode method
decode_tokens_with_hf_byte_bpe: decode a space-separated string of BPE token IDs back to text using the decode method
check_beginning_of_word: check if a token is the beginning of a word using the is_beginning_of_word method
register_hf_byte_bpe_encoder: register the HuggingFace ByteLevel BPE encoder with fairseq using the hf_byte_bpe name
configure_bpe_args: configure BPE merges, vocab, and prefix space arguments using the add_args static method
